add-png-logo-to-first-page.title: Add PNG Logo to First Page of PDF
add-png-logo-to-first-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating an ImageStamp from a PNG file, positioning it on the first page, and saving the modified document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages
add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent background image on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by creating an ImageStamp, setting its opacity, and applying it to each page.

add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Transparent PNG Overlay to PDF Pages
add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a transparent PNG image on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring the overlay appears above existing content.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place an image watermark on every page of a PDF and rotate it 45 degrees for diagonal placement using Aspose.Pdf.

add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Company Logo to First Page of PDF
add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a centered image stamp (logo) on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Image to Each PDF Page
add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a decorative header image at the top of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with alignment and margin settings to avoid overlapping existing content.

add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Footer Image to Each PDF Page
add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a decorative footer image on every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, scaling the image proportionally to the page width.

add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Pattern Image to PDF Pages
add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent pattern image as a background on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Background Pattern Image to PDF Pages
add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.description: This example shows how to overlay a semi‑transparent pattern image as a background on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages
add-background-image-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, iterating its pages, and adding a background image using ImageStamp with opacity to simulate a multiply blend effect.

add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Texture Image to PDF Pages
add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent background image on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.title: Add Semi-Transparent Overlay Image to PDF
add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent PNG across all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.title: Add Theme‑Based Semi‑Transparent Overlay to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.description: The example reads a JSON theme configuration to obtain RGBA values, then uses Aspose.Pdf to add a semi‑transparent colored rectangle overlay to every page of a PDF and saves the result.

add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.title: Add Semi-Transparent Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a PNG watermark with configurable opacity on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.title: Replace JPEG with PNG on PDF Page Using Resources.Images
replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace an existing JPEG image on the third page of a PDF with a higher‑resolution PNG by manipulating the Resources.Images collection.

replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.title: Replace JPEG Images with PNG in PDF
replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages and image elements, and swapping each image's data for a PNG placeholder while preserving positioning.

vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.title: Replace Raster Images with SVG Vectors in PDF
vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.description: Shows how to locate raster images in a PDF, find matching SVG files, and replace the raster images with vector equivalents using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.title: Replace Images on Odd PDF Pages with Placeholder
replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages, and on each odd‑numbered page replaces every existing image with a placeholder graphic while preserving the original image dimensions.

replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.title: Replace Images on Odd PDF Pages with QR Code Placeholder
replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.description: The example loads a PDF, removes all images from each odd‑numbered page, and inserts a QR‑code placeholder image in their place.

replace-images-last-page-with-banner.title: Replace Images on Last PDF Page with Full-Width Banner
replace-images-last-page-with-banner.description: Loads a PDF, removes all images from its last page, and adds a banner image that spans the full page width using Aspose.Pdf.

compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.title: Compress Large Images in PDF
compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.description: Demonstrates detecting images larger than 1 MB in a PDF and applying Aspose.Pdf optimization to recompress them, reducing the overall file size.

replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.title: Replace Appendix Images with Placeholder in PDF
replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.description: The example loads a PDF, detects the start of the appendix section, and overlays each appendix page with a full‑page placeholder image while optionally setting alternative text for existing images.

convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.title: Convert PDF Images to Monochrome
convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a PDF, extract each embedded image, convert it to a grayscale bitmap, and replace the original image with the monochrome version using Aspose.Pdf.

correct-pdf-image-orientation.title: Correct EXIF Orientation of Images in PDF
correct-pdf-image-orientation.description: The example loads a PDF, scans each embedded image for EXIF orientation metadata, rotates/flips the image to its proper orientation, and replaces the original image in the PDF.

compress-large-images-in-pdf.title: Compress Large Images in PDF Using OptimizationOptions
compress-large-images-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to reduce PDF size by compressing images (especially those larger than 2 MB) using Aspose.Pdf's OptimizationOptions and saving the optimized document.

replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.title: Replace PDF Images with QR Code Placeholders
replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over each page's images, and adds a text annotation that serves as a QR‑code placeholder linking to the original image source.

replace-images-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Specific Images on a PDF Page Using a Dictionary
replace-images-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to replace selected images on a given PDF page by mapping image indices to new image files with Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.title: Embed ICC Profile into PDF Images
replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate over each image on every page, and embed an ICC color profile into the image using Aspose.Pdf, handling version differences via reflection.

replace-images-with-logo.title: Replace PDF Page Images with a New Logo
replace-images-with-logo.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page and its Paragraphs collection, and replaces every raster image with a specified logo while preserving the original image dimensions.

replace-title-page-banner.title: Replace Title Page Image with High‑Resolution Banner
replace-title-page-banner.description: Demonstrates how to clear existing images on the first PDF page and insert a high‑resolution banner that fills the entire page using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-index-page-images-with-banner.title: Replace Index Page Images with a Banner Image
replace-index-page-images-with-banner.description: Shows how to clear all existing images from the first PDF page and add a single banner image using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-images-from-pdf.title: Remove All Images from a PDF
remove-all-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, delete all images from the page resources, and save the resulting PDF without images.

remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Low-Resolution Images from PDF
remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to scan a PDF for image placements, calculate each image's DPI, and delete images whose DPI is below 72 using Aspose.Pdf's ImagePlacementAbsorber.

remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Duplicate Images from PDF Pages
remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, computes a SHA‑256 hash for each image on every page, identifies duplicate images by hash, removes the duplicates, and saves the cleaned document.

collect-image-resolution-metadata.title: Collect Image Resolution Metadata from PDF Pages
collect-image-resolution-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through each page's image collection, and gather width, height, and DPI information for reporting.

resize-images-half-size.title: Resize Images on PDF Pages to Half Size
resize-images-half-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's paragraphs, locate Image objects and set their ImageScale to 50% before saving the modified document.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.title: Resize Images in PDF Using Configurable Scale Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.description: Demonstrates how to read a scaling factor from a configuration file and resize every image in a PDF by creating scaled ImageStamps for each page.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.title: Resize Images in PDF Using Configurable Scaling Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.description: The example reads a scaling factor from appsettings.json and applies it to every image in a PDF by setting the ImageScale property, then saves the modified document.

resize-images-on-pdf-pages.title: Resize Images on PDF Pages Using JSON Configuration
resize-images-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, reading page‑specific image dimensions from a JSON file, and resizing raster images on each page using Aspose.Pdf before saving the result.

add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Raster Image to a New PDF Page
add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a raster image from a file stream and insert it onto a newly added PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's Image class and the Paragraphs collection.

insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.title: Insert Raster Image into PDF at Absolute Position
insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create an ImageStamp for a raster image, place it using absolute coordinates, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-embedded-raster-image.title: Resize Embedded Raster Images in PDF
resize-embedded-raster-image.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate over its pages and embedded images, and resize each image by setting its width and height before saving the document.

replace-image-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Existing Image on PDF Pages with a New Image
replace-image-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, clear existing image resources on each page, and add a new image using an ImageStamp to replace the original images.

delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.title: Remove Specific Raster Image from PDF Page
delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to delete a particular raster image from a PDF page by removing it from the page resources and cleaning up any content objects that reference it using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-raster-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Raster Images from PDF to PNG
extract-raster-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, extract all raster XImage objects, and save them as separate PNG files.

extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.title: Extract Raster Images from PDF Preserving Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.description: The example opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterates through each page's image resources, detects each image's original format from its header, and saves the images to disk with the correct file extension.

extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Images from PDFs
extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process multiple PDF files in a folder and extract all embedded images to a designated output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add DICOM Image to PDF Using FileStream
add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates loading a DICOM medical image from a FileStream and inserting it into a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf.

insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.title: Insert DICOM Image with Custom Size into PDF
insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.description: Demonstrates how to load a DICOM image, set explicit width and height, and embed it into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.title: Render PDF Page to PNG with Fallback Font
render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.description: Demonstrates how to render a specific PDF page to a PNG image while specifying a fallback font using Aspose.Pdf's RenderingOptions.

render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.title: Render PDF Pages to JPEG with Font Substitution
render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.description: The example loads a PDF, registers a global font substitution to use a specified default font for missing glyphs, and renders each page to a JPEG image.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.title: Create PNG Thumbnails for PDF Pages
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through each page, and generates a 150x200 PNG thumbnail for every page using Aspose.Pdf's PngDevice.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.title: Render PDF Pages to PNG with Custom Font
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.description: Shows how to set a default font for rendering and convert each page of a PDF into PNG images using Aspose.Pdf.

render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.title: Render PDF Pages to TIFF with LZW Compression and Font Fallback
render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.description: Loads a PDF, sets a default font fallback for missing characters, and renders each page to a separate TIFF file using LZW compression.

export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.title: Export PDF Pages to BMP Images at 300 DPI
export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.description: Shows how to convert each page of a PDF into a high‑resolution BMP image (300 DPI) using Aspose.Pdf's BmpDevice and Resolution classes.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.title: Convert PDF to Multi-Page TIFF with Default Font Substitution
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.description: Shows how to convert an entire PDF document to a multi-page TIFF file using Aspose.Pdf while applying a default font substitution to handle missing fonts.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract Vector Graphics from a PDF Page
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Shows how to load a PDF, retrieve the vector graphics (form XObjects) from a specific page, and copy them into a new PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

move-vector-graphic-position.title: Move Vector Graphic by Adjusting Its Matrix
move-vector-graphic-position.description: Demonstrates how to shift vector graphics on a PDF page by modifying the Matrix property of XObjects, including version‑agnostic handling via reflection.

remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.title: Remove a Vector Graphic (Path Operator) from a PDF Page
remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.description: Shows how to locate a Path operator representing a vector graphic in a PDF page's contents collection and delete it using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.title: Insert Extracted SVG Vector Graphic into PDF Page
copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates extracting a vector graphic from a source PDF as SVG, loading it as an Image, and inserting it into the Paragraphs collection of a target PDF page.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract PDF Pages to SVG Files
batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.description: Loads each PDF from an input folder, creates a dedicated sub‑folder for the file, and saves every page as an SVG vector graphic using Aspose.Pdf.

add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.title: Add Alternative Text to PDF Images
add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.description: The example loads a PDF, iterates through each page and its image resources, assigns alternative text to each image to improve accessibility for screen readers, and saves the updated document.

retrieve-image-alt-text.title: Retrieve Image Alternative Text from PDF and Log It
retrieve-image-alt-text.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page and image, extracts the image's AlternativeText (using reflection for version safety), and writes the alt text to the console for auditing.

add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.title: Add Image with Alt Text to PDF
add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert an image into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and assign alternative text for accessibility purposes.

render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.title: Render PDF Pages to PNG at 300 DPI
render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.description: Demonstrates how to convert each page of a PDF into a 300‑DPI PNG image using Aspose.Pdf, with optional default font configuration.

replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.title: Replace Vector Graphic with Raster Image in PDF
replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.description: Demonstrates how to locate a vector Path object on a PDF page, remove it, and insert a raster image (ImageStamp) at the same position using Aspose.Pdf.
